scope: Read-only comparison of playerService/editListenService and tests against /tmp/ear-refine-fixes-20261016/baseline

evidence.detail: Entry records prior playing state and stops the old source before selecting the edit region.
Processed pending state clears the old buffer before awaiting render; player.play() cannot fall through to the source.
Active/disposed/generation/mode/settings guards prevent late resumption; tests cover leave, dispose, region and mode changes.
Only entry that interrupted playback resumes, and only after a usable dry/processed state exists.
Visibility toggles call downstream route refresh, with no pause/play or source recreation.
Playing refresh reconnects output only; idle refresh updates graph only.
Delayed worklet completion after graph disable does not restore it: sourceCount=1, sourceStopCount=0, current cursor=5, original cue=2.
Non-LR monitor mode or an active band selection independently require the live graph, regardless of meter visibility.
Mode, edge and mask events refresh routing so graph creation/destruction follows monitor state.
With analysis hidden, switching to S mode activates the graph; LR/bypass restores a single direct output path without restarting the source.

validation.limitations: Topology and clock evidence comes from instrumented mock nodes; this does not assert acoustic glitch-free output in a real browser.
